## Description {#details}

The <code>include</code> folder contains all public header files for the µTest++ testing framework, serving as the main interface for users and integrators.

Within this folder, you will find declarations for core framework components, including test suite and test case management, test runner control, result reporting, mathematical utilities, type traits, user-defined literals, operators, and supporting utilities. All public API definitions are organised here to ensure a clear distinction from implementation details, which are located in the <code>src</code> folder.

The structure of the <code>include</code> folder promotes modularity, maintainability, and straightforward integration. By including the relevant headers from this folder, users can access the full range of features provided by the µTest++ framework in their projects.
